In [[Five-dimensional space|five-dimensional]] [[geometry]], a '''cantellated 5-orthoplex''' is a convex [[uniform 5-polytope]], being a [[cantellation]] of the regular [[5-orthoplex]].

There are 6 cantellation for the 5-orthoplex, including truncations. Some of them are more easily constructed from the dual [[5-cube]].

{{TOC left}}
{{-}}

=== Alternate names ===
* Cantellated 5-orthoplex
* Bicantellated 5-demicube
* Small rhombated triacontaditeron (Acronym: sart) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/sart.htm (x3o3x3o4o - sart)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
The vertices of the can be made in 5-space, as permutations and sign combinations of:
: (0,0,1,1,2)

=== Images ===
The cantellated 5-orthoplex is constructed by a [[cantellation]] operation applied to the 5-orthoplex.
{{5-cube Coxeter plane graphs|t24|120}}

=== Alternate names ===
* Cantitruncated pentacross
* Cantitruncated triacontaditeron (Acronym: gart) (Jonathan Bowers){{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/gart.htm (x3x3x3o4o - gart)]}}

=== Coordinates ===
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of a cantitruncated 5-orthoplex, centered at the origin, are all sign and coordinate [[permutation]]s of
: (±3,±2,±1,0,0)

=== Images ===
{{5-cube Coxeter plane graphs|t234|120}}

== Related polytopes ==
These polytopes are from a set of 31 [[uniform 5-polytope]]s generated from the regular [[5-cube]] or [[5-orthoplex]].

{{Penteract family}}
